author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0006735 'NADH regeneration' and 'GO:0006740 NADPH regeneration'
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29818

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1prQ06wDoQli0F0FWOSTboQt6QyxD79smPNcPKVNCEQA/edit?gid=0#gid=0
title: Review annotations to GO:0006735 'NADH regeneration' and 'GO:0006740 NADPH regeneration'
